<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-cli-docs.sh from the libfossil --help output. Do not edit; change the help text in cli/ and run make docs-gen. -->

```text
Usage: libfossil repo cone <command>

Show or edit a checkout's sparse cone

Flags:
  -h, --help           Show context-sensitive help.
  -R, --repo=STRING    Path to repository file
  -v, --verbose        Verbose output

Commands:
  repo cone show [flags]
    List the cone's members ("dense" when there is none)

  repo cone add <paths> ... [flags]
    Widen the cone, or with --not carve paths out of it

  repo cone remove <paths> ... [flags]
    Remove members of either polarity

  repo cone set <paths> ... [flags]
    Replace the cone

  repo cone dense [flags]
    Drop the cone and materialize every file

  repo cone test <paths> ... [flags]
    Classify paths against the cone and name the deciding member

  repo cone store [<paths> ...] [flags]
    Show or replace the repository's store cone, fetching what widening covers

  repo cone deepen <checkin> [flags]
    Move the store's horizon down to reach a check-in, fetching the history it
    keeps

  repo cone compact
    Drop held blobs the store cone elides (irreversible locally)

  repo cone cost <checkin>
    Report what each horizon rule would hold at a check-in, from this repository
```

      --sync-private        Allow recovery of private required artifacts

## repo cone store

```text
Usage: libfossil repo cone store [<paths> ...] [flags]

Show or replace the repository's store cone, fetching what widening covers

Arguments:
  [<paths> ...]    Inclusion members; none shows the store cone

Flags:
  -h, --help                Show context-sensitive help.
  -R, --repo=STRING         Path to repository file
  -v, --verbose             Verbose output

      --remote=STRING       Required-content peer URL (default: saved
                            last-sync-url)
      --sync-user=STRING    Required-content authentication user
      --sync-pass=STRING    Required-content password (never saved)
      --sync-private        Allow recovery of private required artifacts
      --timeout=10m         Required-content deadline; 0 disables it
      --not=NOT,...         Exclusion members (repeatable)
      --dense               Drop the store cone, fetching everything it elided
      --horizon=STRING      Elide blobs below this check-in (name, branch or
                            hash prefix), fetching what a deeper horizon keeps;
                            'repo cone cost' shows what each rule would hold
      --leaves              With --horizon, also hold every open leaf's ancestry
                            back to the check-in, for merging across live
                            branches offline; costly: on a repository with old
                            unmerged branches that is nearly the whole history
      --structural          With --horizon, also elide the manifests below the
                            check-in; the next pull fetches the origin's seed
      --no-horizon          Drop the horizon, keeping the path members,
                            and fetch what it elided
```
